title: DLWP/1 Frame Header
description: The fixed 24-byte header that prefixes every DLWP/1 frame. See RFC-0001 section 3. On the wire every field is big-endian. This schema describes the decoded logical form used by the conformance vectors and the diagnostic frame dump.

magic.description: ASCII 'DLWP'. A mismatch terminates the connection.

flags.description: Bit field defined in RFC-0001 section 3.1. Bits 4-7 are reserved and must be zero on send.

header_length.description: Total header length in bytes, including this 24-byte prefix. Must be 24 in version 1.0.

message_type.description: Frame type. See RFC-0001 section 4 for the registry.

channel_id.description: Logical channel. 0 is the control channel and is always valid.

sequence_number.description: Per-session, monotonically increasing, starts at 1. Receivers reject non-increasing values with ERR_REPLAY_DETECTED.

acknowledgment.description: Highest received sequence number observed on this channel, or 0 when not applicable.

body_length.description: Length of the body in bytes, excluding the header. For an encrypted frame this is 12 + plaintext_length + 16.

allOf.description: body_length must not exceed MAX_FRAME_BYTES plus the AEAD overhead.

$comment: Encrypted bodies are 12 + L + 16 bytes, so the maximum legal body_length for a 16 MiB plaintext is 16777244. The schema caps body_length at 16777217 only to express the header's integer width; the enforcement limit lives in RFC-0001 section 2 and is exercised by protocol/vectors/malformed.json.
